Which statement about gravitational field strength is not correct?
A
It changes the mass of an object.
B
It is equivalent to the acceleration of free fall.
C
It is measured in N/kg.
D
Its magnitude is different on other planets in our Solar system.

options.label: A
options.text: It changes the mass of an object.

options.label: B
options.text: It is equivalent to the acceleration of free fall.

options.label: D
options.text: Its magnitude is different on other planets in our Solar system.
